mapper.select: SELECT product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit, num FROM (SELECT product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit, rownum as num FROM (SELECT /*+ INDEX_ASC(cocktail_product c_prod_product_no_pk)*/product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit FROM cocktail_product)) WHERE num BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM cocktail_product ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM ) WHERE rownum<=1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM cocktail_product ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM ) WHERE rownum<=12

SELECT product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit, num FROM (SELECT product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit, rownum as num FROM (SELECT /*+ INDEX_ASC(cocktail_product c_prod_product_no_pk)*/product_no, name, type, price, poster, deliver, alc, volumn, loc, content, cno, hit FROM cocktail_product WHERE ${fd} LIKE '%'||#{ss}||'%')) WHERE num BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/12.0) FROM cocktail_product WHERE ${fd} LIKE '%'||#{ss}||'%'
